AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND a.status = #{status}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.content, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.view_count, a.publish_time FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 1
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_article_tag wat WHERE wat.article_id = a.id AND wat.tag_id = #{tagId} )
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_article_tag wat2 INNER JOIN tb_tag wt2 ON wat2.tag_id = wt2.id WHERE wat2.article_id = a.id AND wt2.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.content, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.view_count, a.publish_time FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, view_count FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1 AND ( publish_time > #{publishTime} OR (publish_time = #{publishTime} AND id > #{id}) ) ORDER BY publish_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, view_count FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1 AND ( publish_time < #{publishTime} OR (publish_time = #{publishTime} AND id < #{id}) ) ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, view_count FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, view_count FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1 AND category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT YEAR(publish_time) AS `year`, MONTH(publish_time) AS `month`, COUNT(*) AS article_count FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY YEAR(publish_time), MONTH(publish_time) ORDER BY `year` DESC, `month` DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.view_count, a.publish_time FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.publish_time >= #{startTime} AND a.publish_time < #{endTime} ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published_count, COUNT(*) AS article_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category) AS category_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tag) AS tag_count FROM tb_article

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1) AS article_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category) AS category_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tag) AS tag_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM tb_article WHERE status = 1) AS view_count
